title: Image Edit
note:
## Image Edit

1. Upload your reference image.
2. Edit the prompt: say what to keep and what to change.
3. Run and review Save Image.

One edited image is generated and saved.

The fixed seed allows unchanged runs to reuse cached outputs. Change the seed or prompt for new results.

Needs a ModelArk key in Settings > BytePlus.

title: Image Variations
note:
## Image Variations

1. Upload your reference image.
2. Edit the prompt: say what to keep and what to change.
3. Run and review Save Image.

Three separate generations use seeds 42, 43 and 44. Save Image saves every result. Increase generation_count for more variations; each image is billed.

The fixed seed allows unchanged runs to reuse cached outputs. Change the seed or prompt for new results.

Needs a ModelArk key in Settings > BytePlus.

title: Generate and Enhance
groups: Image: Seedream, then Image Quality Enhance
Video: Seedance, then vCube Video Enhance (enable as needed)

title: Image and Video References
note:
## Image + Video References

1. Upload an image: **@Image 1** supplies the subject's appearance and style.
2. Upload a video: **@Video 1** supplies camera movement and pacing.
3. Edit the prompt to assign a clear role to each reference, then Run.

Use exactly **@Image 1** and **@Video 1**, including the space before the number. Numbering is separate for each media type: image_1 is @Image 1, video_1 is @Video 1. These are reference labels, not filenames.

**task_type = reference** creates a new video. Choose **edit** to modify the input clip, or **extend** to continue it, and rewrite the prompt accordingly.

Needs a ModelArk key in Settings > BytePlus and a Comfy.org login for local video upload. Each generation is billed. Fixed seed reuses unchanged cached outputs.

title: Image to Video - Seedance 2.5 and 2.0
note:
## Image to video

1. Upload your image as the **first frame**.
2. Edit the prompt to describe motion.
3. Run **Seedance 2.5** at 720p, 5 seconds.
4. To compare, select both purple **Seedance 2.0** nodes and press **Ctrl+B**, then run again.

Keep seeds **fixed** and inputs unchanged to reuse the first result. Each enabled model generates a separately billed video. To use only 2.0, bypass both 2.5 nodes first.

Optional: connect a last frame for a first-to-last transition. Both models also offer 1080p. Needs a ModelArk key in Settings > BytePlus.

title: Image to Draft to 1080p
groups: 2. Enable both nodes for the 1080p final
note:
## Image to Draft to 1080p

1. Upload an image and edit the draft prompt.
2. Run to save a **480p draft**.
3. Review it in Save Video.
4. Select both purple final nodes and press **Ctrl+B** to enable them, then run again.

Keep the draft seed **fixed** and its inputs unchanged to reuse the reviewed draft. Final uses **draft_task_id**, preserving scene and motion at **1080p**. Draft and final are billed separately.

Draft IDs can be rendered for 7 days. After restarting ComfyUI, paste a saved draft ID into Draft to Final in a separate workflow to avoid generating another draft.

title: Seedance Video Extension
note:
## Seedance video extension

Clip 1 is a normal text-to-video. Each **Extension** node is *Seedance 2.5 Reference to Video* with **task_type = extend**: it receives the previous clip as its reference video and continues it forward, picking up the motion, the scene and the sound where that clip stopped. The extension contains only the new seconds, so **Concatenate Video** joins clip 1 and both extensions into one 15 s video.

Write what should happen next in each extension prompt (start with 'Extend the video forward'). To add a third extension, copy an Extension node and feed it the previous one. A connected reference video is uploaded through Comfy.org storage, so log in to your Comfy.org account in ComfyUI. Needs a ModelArk key in Settings > BytePlus.

title: Seedance Task Query
note:
## Seedance task query

A Seedance task keeps running on BytePlus after you close ComfyUI, and its result stays for 24 hours. Paste a **task ID** and this node collects it: how many tasks matched, their status and the model that made them.

Where to find a task ID: the *Task ID* line in the ComfyUI console while a video runs, the *draft_task_id* output of a Seedance 2.5 Draft node, or leave the ID empty to list your latest tasks (filter with *status* and *model_version*).

Needs a ModelArk key in Settings > BytePlus.

title: Video and Audio Assets
keys: IAM access key and secret key
note:
## Video and audio assets

Register a **video** and an **audio clip** in your private asset library, list the library, and reference both by their `asset://` URIs in **Seedance 2.5 Reference** (inputs *asset_1* and *asset_2*).

A sample clip and a sample voice line are generated so the template runs as it is. To use your own media, paste public https links into *video_url* / *audio_url*, or connect *Load Video* / *Load Audio* to the *video* / *audio* sockets (local uploads need a Comfy.org login).

Needs a ModelArk key, a Seed Speech key and IAM AK/SK with asset-library permission in Settings > BytePlus.

title: Image to UGC Video
note:
## Image to UGC video

1. Load your **product photo** and describe the product in **Product brief**.
2. **BytePlus LLM** looks at the photo and writes a one-line script and a handheld, selfie-style shot prompt.
3. **Seedance 2.5 Reference** shoots a 9:16 creator video with your product as the reference image.
4. **Seed TTS** reads the script as a voiceover and the core video nodes put it on the clip.

Change the voice in *Voiceover*, the length in *Creator video* (8 s default). Needs a ModelArk key and a Seed Speech key in Settings > BytePlus.

title: Product Ad in One Click
note:
## Product ad in one click

Type a **one-line brief**. The LLM writes an image prompt and a motion prompt, **Seedream 5.0 Pro** makes the 16:9 hero shot, **Seedance 2.0** animates it, and **vCube** upscales and cleans the clip to 1080p.

vCube takes the clip as a link (the Seedance response), so no Comfy.org login is needed. Needs a ModelArk key and a MediaKit key in Settings > BytePlus.

title: Old Photo to Living Memory
note:
## Old photo to living memory

1. **Image Quality Enhance** restores and upscales the photo.
2. **Seedance 2.0** animates the restored photo (first frame only) with subtle, natural motion.
3. **Video Smoothness Enhance** finishes the clip.

The first group creates a stand-in old photo so the template runs as it is. To use your own photo, delete that group and paste a public https link into *image_url* of the restore node (or connect a Load Image; local images need a Comfy.org login). Needs ModelArk and MediaKit keys in Settings > BytePlus.

title: Podcast Clip
note:
## Podcast clip

Write a topic. The LLM writes a short HOST and GUEST dialogue, **Seed TTS** voices both speakers, **Seed ASR** turns the result into SRT subtitles and **Seedream** paints the cover art.

Change the voices in *Host voice* and *Guest voice*. Needs ModelArk and Seed Speech keys in Settings > BytePlus.

title: Multilingual Dubbing
note:
## Multilingual dubbing

1. Load a speech clip in **Speech to dub**.
2. **Seed ASR** transcribes it.
3. **BytePlus LLM** translates it. The target language is in the LLM's *system_prompt* (default Japanese); change it there.
4. **Seed TTS** speaks the translation. Pick a voice for that language in *Dub*.

Needs ModelArk and Seed Speech keys in Settings > BytePlus.

title: Product Lookbook
note:
## Lookbook from sequential images

One prompt, one reference photo, **four coherent images**: set *max_images* in the Seedream node (up to 15 with the reference images counted) and describe each scene in the prompt.

Needs a ModelArk key in Settings > BytePlus.

title: Sound Design
note:
## Sound design with Seed Audio

Describe a scene. The LLM turns it into a sound-design prompt, **Seed Audio 1.0** renders **two takes** (*generation_count*), and Save keeps both.

Needs ModelArk and Seed Speech keys in Settings > BytePlus.

title: Consistent Character Shots
keys: IAM access key and secret key
note:
## Consistent character across shots

Describe a character. **Seedream** paints the portrait, **Create Image Asset** registers it in your private asset library, and three **Seedance 2.0 Reference** shots use the asset as *asset_1*: write `asset1` in each prompt and the same person appears in every shot. **Concatenate Video** joins them.

The asset can be reused in later runs: use *Asset Library* to find it, or paste its ID into *asset_1*. Needs a ModelArk key and IAM AK/SK with asset-library permission in Settings > BytePlus.
